assessment: The response is consistently honest, non-accusatory, and precise about policy limits: it never implies fraud, performs only the two permitted checks, and clearly distinguishes a progress update from a guaranteed decision. The paste-ready message is a standout mitigation that reduces the customer's handoff burden. The main weakness is ownership: the candidate routes review initiation back to the customer rather than offering to open it, leaving the two-business-day window unanchored to any concrete commitment. Refund timing was also dropped in the final-turn summary. Overall a strong performance with a structural, not attitudinal, gap.
judge_agreement: All five judges agreed strongly on policy honesty (8-10) and on the value of the copy-paste handoff template. Four of five clustered empathy at 7-8, with only the google judge at 10. The sharpest disagreement was resolution quality: four judges clustered at 5-8, consistently flagging the customer-owned handoff as the main weakness, while the google judge scored 10, treating the same handoff as a well-handled limitation rather than a failure of ownership.
